messages.subject: Department Chair and Professor of Psychology at the University of Tulsa
parts:
Dear Colleagues,

The Psychology Department at the University of Tulsa (TU) is searching for a senior faculty member to lead the department. Please share this email with anyone who may be interested in this position. We are seeking candidates with industrial/organizational (I/O), clinical, or other expertise that complements TU's clinical and I/O graduate programs. We would greatly appreciate having a senior faculty member with expertise in methodology.

The posting can be found by clicking HERE or using the web address below:
https://universitytulsa.peopleadmin.com/postings/9535

If you have any questions about the position, please don't hesitate to contact the search committee chair, Elana Newman, PhD, at Elana-...@utulsa.edu. I am also happy to assist with any inquiries as a member of the search committee.

Thank you for your consideration!

Sincerely,
Juseob

--
Juseob Lee, Ph.D.
Assistant Professor
Department of Psychology
The University of Tulsa
